name: Yomoda Shiori
source:
A senior member of the library committee in which the protagonist participates.
She is introverted and lacks in communication skills, but she often talks with the protagonist because they share the same geeky interests.

When the protagonist was rejected in the past, she stood by him and encouraged him. Her kindness touched the protagonist, leading him to become attracted to her.

[translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ418575.html/]DLSite[/url]]
